resources.string: Include a repository after reviewing its current branch and connection. Automatic pull fetches and fast-forwards when safe. Automatic push creates commits from local changes and uploads them. Diverged histories, incoming changes with local edits, and changed connections need review.

Android schedules checks about every 15 minutes or later, depending on connectivity, battery and system restrictions. Run now requests an earlier check. Force-stopping the app prevents background work until you open it again.
Automatically commit and push local changes

GitSync.md can stage local changes, create commits using each repository’s author identity and upload them for included repositories on their reviewed branch. It never force-pushes, merges diverged histories or switches branches. Turning this off stops future steps; completed commits and uploads remain.
Check requested. Waiting for Android and a connection.

Needs review. Open the repository to resolve local changes, divergence, missing upstream or a saved commit awaiting upload.
Connection, authentication, trust or file access needs attention. Open the repository and retry there.
Could not complete this action. Reload and review the current repository and settings.

Unreadable Background Sync settings cannot authorize work. Reset removes only its saved policies and health, with both automatic modes off. Repository files, accounts and other sync features are kept. Review each repository again before including it.
